biography:
As lead counsel and strategic negotiator, I bring extensive experience in large-scale infrastructure projects across various industries (including phosphate, energy, and data centers) and geographies. My strong track record in advising on global transactions and collaborating effectively with international and multi-disciplinary teams throughout all stages of the project life cycle - from development, financing, construction, operation, to refinancing and corporate M&A, has enabled me to lead successful negotiations with key stakeholders and play a vital role in shaping business strategy and growth.

I am deeply passionate about contributing to a more sustainable and equitable future for all. As a WeForest trustee, I am committed to supporting the organization's efforts to restore forest ecosystems and improve the livelihoods of local communities to mitigate the effects of climate change.
